results.notes: CORRECTION-23J §10 — the caveat that stood here cited 10,724 of 59,286 attempted camps. That figure does not reproduce on the commit it shipped in: running the same audit unmodified at 0955c87 gives 343 of 3,672 (9.34%). The old number described an intermediate dirty-tree state, not committed behaviour. What this fixture pins is the READER alone — a held negative refuses a camp — which is true and is all it tests. Whether a LAUNCH ever informs a camp is J8/J11, and the answer there is no.
